name: Van Halen 1984
reference: Panama / Hot for Teacher, plus the Jump guitar solo: 1984 (1984, 5150 Studios, prod. Ted Templeman, eng. Donn Landee)
rig: Kramer 5150 / Frankenstrat-derived guitars -> the Variac'd Marshall Super Lead, hotter and drier than Van Halen I -> Marshall 4x12
notes: Amp = Slammin 1959HW Variac at 190 V, dimed 7, with the capture's 8 dB clean boost baked in: the tighter, hotter 1984 sound. Cab = plain Greenback 1960TV SM57 instead of the song-voiced 'panama ir' (unknown quality). Drier room (480L Large Wood Room 12%) for 5150 Studios. SW8 LEAD = TS9 push + 380 ms solo echo. Unconfirmed [verify]: which Kramer per song and whether a preamp or boost sat in front of the Marshall. No flanger. Levels are unmeasured. Research: 80s-tones.md shortlist (captures and model ids checked with `tone3000.py models`).
